data.title: Civilian defense. Here is a portable electric power saw to cut flooring and heavy beams. It is part of the equipment of the New York City Emergency Service truck displayed in October at the civilian defense show at Madison Square Garden by the New York Police Department. This saw, which operates on 110-volt direct current generated by the truck, can be used as far as 2000 feet from the truck

data.name: 2001 Ford 550 Crane Truck Utility Body Liftmoore Crane
data.description: Garage Kept 2001 Ford 550 Utility Body with Liftmoore Crane This well-maintained 2001 Ford 550 features a utility body equipped with a reliable Liftmoore crane. It has only 34,000 miles and comes with a new Pennsylvania state inspection. All maintenance records are available, including state inspections and yearly crane inspections, ensuring the trucks excellent condition. The truck also includes a plow with controls, a new salt spreader, and new salt spreader controls, making it fully equipped for winter and utility work.
